summary: Russian forces conducted a massive three-hour combined strike on Odesa region employing up to 70 Shahed-type UAVs, jet-powered Geran-3/4 variants, Su-34/30/57-launched KABs, Kh-59, Kh-69, and Kh-31P missiles targeting port infrastructure. Simultaneous ballistic missile strikes hit Boryspil district killing one and injuring five, while a strike on Kryvyi Rih killed 16 with 130 injured. Ukrainian forces struck Russian oil refineries in Yeysk, Novokuybyshevsk, Chapayevsk, and Perm.
key_points: Massive combined Russian strike on Odesa region used up to 70 Geran-2, jet Geran-3/4, KABs from Su-34, Kh-59 from Su-34, likely Kh-69 from Su-57, and Kh-31P from Su-30 targeting port infrastructure over three hours. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70935)
Russian ballistic missiles struck Boryspil district killing one person and injuring five, damaging warehouse, parking, vehicles, and a gas station. (Source: @UkraineNow/83616)
Russian strike on Kryvyi Rih resulted in 16 dead, 9 missing including two children, and 130 injured including 25 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/83608)
Ukrainian defense forces struck Yeysk oil refinery in Krasnodar Krai, used for supplying Russian army, per General Staff. (Source: @UkraineNow/83622)
France will deliver interceptor missiles for Ukrainian air defense and confirmed readiness to provide missile production licenses. (Source: @UkraineNow/83621)
Russian MoD claimed strikes on two Ukrainian trains delivering military cargo in Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @tass_agency/391521)

Ukrainian UAVs attacked Russian territory including Syktyvkar (Komi), Krasnoyarsk, Belgorod (bus damaged), and Kursk region (garage attack injuring one). (Source: @eRadarrua/106731, @eRadarrua/106749, @eRadarrua/106752, @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Putin stated Russian offensive tempo increased, retaliatory strikes more destructive than Ukrainian strikes, and no breakthrough from Ukrainian strikes; Lavrov said Russia won't negotiate with current Europe. (Source: @tass_agency/391544, @tass_agency/391543, @tass_agency/391541, @tass_agency/391522)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted a massive three-hour combined strike on Odesa region employing up to 70 Shahed-type UAVs, jet-powered Geran-3/4 variants, Su-34/30/57-launched KABs, Kh-59, Kh-69, and Kh-31P missiles targeting port infrastructure. Simultaneous ballistic missile strikes hit Boryspil district killing one and injuring five, while a strike on Kryvyi Rih killed 16 with 130 injured. Ukrainian forces struck Russian oil refineries in Yeysk, Novokuybyshevsk, Chapayevsk, and Perm.

points: Ukrainian air defense forces engaged massive Russian aerial assault across multiple regions, with monitoring channels reporting cruise missiles over Kyiv, Zhytomyr, and Brovary, jet-powered UAVs approaching Poltava, Mykolaiv, Zaporizhzhia, and Chornomorsk, and ballistic threats from Bryansk region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70905, @mon1tor_ua/70906, @mon1tor_ua/70925, @mon1tor_ua/70931, @mon1tor_ua/70934, @mon1tor_ua/70937, @kpszsu/74028, @kpszsu/74006, @kpszsu/74020, @kpszsu/74017, @eRadarrua/106744, @eRadarrua/106719)

Ukraine unveiled its first domestic jet-powered interceptor UAV designed to destroy Russian strike drones including Geran-3, Geran-4, Geran-5, and Shahed-131, as well as reconnaissance UAVs and helicopters, adding a new layer to air defense capabilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/83599)

Ukrainian forces struck key Russian energy infrastructure: Yeysk oil refinery in Krasnodar Krai (per General Staff), Novokuybyshevsk oil refinery in Samara region, warehouse facilities in Chapayevsk (Samara region), and an oil refinery in Perm, demonstrating deep-strike capacity. (Source: @UkraineNow/83622, @UkraineNow/83604, @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

President Zelensky signed a decree to hold a competition for a monument to Ivan Mazepa in Kyiv, while Verkhovna Rada Speaker Stefanchuk criticized former Defense Minister Fedorov's call for elections under martial law as "absolutely impossible and irresponsible." (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32663, @ukr_leaks_eng/32647)

Reports indicate several hundred Ukrainian soldiers have fled training exercises in Germany since 2022, with over 80 cases in Saxony-Anhalt alone, highlighting potential morale and retention challenges. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32647)

In Odesa region, a woman physically expelled Territorial Recruitment Center (TCC) employees attempting to detain a man from a store, reflecting social tensions around mobilization. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32650)

President Putin claimed Russian troops increased offensive tempo and "confidently solve SVO tasks," asserting retaliatory strikes are more destructive than Ukrainian strikes on Russia, that strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure are "effective and timely" helping frontline troops, and that no strategic breakthrough resulted from Ukrainian attacks. (Source: @tass_agency/391544, @tass_agency/391543, @tass_agency/391538, @tass_agency/391541, @tass_agency/391545)

Russian forces executed a massive combined strike on Odesa region lasting three hours, employing up to 70 regular Geran-2 (Shahed), controlled Geran-2, jet-powered Geran-3 (Odesa, Chornomorsk), controlled jet Geran-4 (Zatoka, Izmail, Chornomorsk, Odesa), KABs from Su-34 (Chornomorsk), Kh-59 from Su-34 (Chornomorsk/Odesa), likely Kh-69 from Su-57 (Chornomorsk/Odesa), and Kh-31P from Su-30 (Chornomorsk/Odesa), targeting port infrastructure. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70935, @mon1tor_ua/70929, @eRadarrua/106722)

Russian ballistic missiles (likely Iskander-M) struck Boryspil district in Kyiv region, killing one and injuring five, damaging a warehouse, parking area, vehicles, and a gas station; high threat of further Iskander-M launches from Bryansk region was reported. (Source: @UkraineNow/83616, @mon1tor_ua/70939, @mon1tor_ua/70940, @mon1tor_ua/70937)
Russian strike on Kryvyi Rih killed 16, left 9 missing (including 2 children), and injured 130 (including 25 children), according to local authorities. (Source: @UkraineNow/83608)
Russian MoD reported striking two Ukrainian trains delivering military cargo in Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @tass_agency/391521)

Russian air defense engaged Ukrainian UAVs over Sevastopol (10 injured including a teenager, 2 dead from debris on a bus), Belgorod (passenger bus damaged), Kursk region (garage attack injuring one), Syktyvkar (Komi Republic), and Krasnoyarsk (fire at commercial pavilions). (Source: @tass_agency/391549, @tass_agency/391535, @eRadarrua/106752, @ukr_leaks_eng/32652, @eRadarrua/106731, @eRadarrua/106749)

Foreign Minister Lavrov stated Russia will not negotiate with the West, declaring "there is simply no one to negotiate with in today's Europe," while United Russia congress approved a new party program for upcoming State Duma elections. (Source: @tass_agency/391522, @tass_agency/391519)
In Sumy region, Russia's "North" group of forces conducts the most active fighting near Pysarivka and Ulianovo, according to Ukrainian monitoring summaries. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

In Kharkiv region's Volchansk sector, the "North" group continues pushing back Ukrainian forces; a counterattack by the 23rd Separate Mechanized Infantry Battalion was repelled and forced to retreat. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Russian jet-powered UAVs were detected over Poltava region (Hadiach, Romny) and Sumy region, indicating continued aerial reconnaissance and strike operations against rear logistics. (Source: @eRadarrua/106744, @mon1tor_ua/70934, @kpszsu/74028, @kpszsu/74006, @eRadarrua/106719)
Russian forces launched KAB glide bombs against Zaporizhzhia region targeting Zaporizhzhia city, per monitoring data. (Source: @kpszsu/74005)

Ukrainian strike on a shopping center in Kryvyi Rih (Dnipropetrovsk region) caused mass casualties (16 dead, 130 injured), marking a significant strike on a major urban center. (Source: @UkraineNow/83608, @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Ukrainian UAVs penetrated deep into Russian territory, with monitoring channels reporting flights over Syktyvkar (Komi Republic) and Krasnoyarsk (Siberia), where a fire destroyed five trade pavilions and a cafe (500 sq m). (Source: @eRadarrua/106731, @eRadarrua/106729, @eRadarrua/106749)

In Belgorod region, an explosion ("cotton") damaged a passenger bus; over the past 24 hours, two civilians killed (one in Nikolskoye from drone detonation, one near Razumnoye from FPV strike), at least 10 injured across multiple districts (Shebekino, Ustinka, Volokonovka, Nikolskoye, Pyatnitskoye, Otradnoye), with damage to homes, cars, businesses, and infrastructure. (Source: @eRadarrua/106752, @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
In Kursk region, a Ukrainian drone attacked a garage attached to a private house in Rzhava village, injuring a man. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region was reported by Ukrainian monitoring, indicating continued strategic missile threat to northern Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70937)
Belarusian Su-30 fighter launched from Baranovichi airfield to intercept a Russian missile, suggesting integrated air defense operations or accidental engagement. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70926)

Massive Russian combined strike on Odesa region (3 hours) targeted port infrastructure with up to 70 Shahed-type UAVs, jet Geran-3/4, KABs, Kh-59, Kh-69, and Kh-31P missiles from Su-34/30/57 aircraft, hitting Chornomorsk, Odesa, Zatoka, Izmail, and Tatarbunary. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70935, @mon1tor_ua/70929, @eRadarrua/106722, @kpszsu/74013, @kpszsu/74016, @kpszsu/74002)
Russian strike on Mykolaiv region killed four people including three children (ages 11, 11, 12), hitting a shop, pharmacy, and post office. (Source: @UkraineNow/83597)
Russian UAV attack on Zaporizhzhia injured at least three people seriously, per OVA head Ivan Fedorov. (Source: @UkraineNow/83599)
Ukrainian UAVs attacked Sevastopol: 10 injured including a teenager from UAV debris hitting a route bus (2 dead, 5 injured per governor Razvozhaev). (Source: @tass_agency/391549, @tass_agency/391535)

Shahed-type UAVs crossed from Odesa region into Moldova and approached Izmail (1 km from Romanian border), indicating airspace violations near NATO borders. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70910, @mon1tor_ua/70932)
Russian forces struck two Ukrainian trains carrying military cargo in Dnipropetrovsk region, per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/391521)

Russia employed a diverse aerial arsenal in the Odesa strike: up to 70 Geran-2 (Shahed-136), controlled Geran-2, jet-powered Geran-3, controlled jet Geran-4, KAB guided bombs from Su-34, Kh-59 cruise missiles from Su-34, likely Kh-69 stealth cruise missiles from Su-57, and Kh-31P anti-radiation missiles from Su-30. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70935)

Ukraine deployed its first domestic jet-powered interceptor UAV capable of destroying Russian strike drones (Geran-3/4/5, Shahed-131), reconnaissance UAVs, and helicopters, marking a technological advancement in air defense. (Source: @UkraineNow/83599)
